function remixVoiceExtracted(config: VoiceRemixConfig, payload: Record<string, any>, name: string | undefined) {

  if (config.gender) {
    payload.gender = config.gender;
  }

  if (config.age) {
    payload.age = config.age;
  }

  if (config.accent) {
    payload.accent = config.accent;
  }

  if (config.style) {
    payload.style = config.style;
  }

  if (config.pacing) {
    payload.pacing = config.pacing;
  }

  if (config.promptStrength) {
    payload.prompt_strength = config.promptStrength;
  } else {
    payload.prompt_strength = 'medium'; // Default
  }

  if (name) {
    payload.name = name;
  }
}

Number of linearly independent paths through the code. Lower is simpler.

| moderate | ≤ 10 |

**Cluster 1:** `constructor`

**Cluster 3:** `processOutputItem`

**Cluster 6:** `processWebSearch`
**Cluster 7:** `processCodeInterpreter`
**Cluster 8:** `processMcpListTools`
**Cluster 9:** `processMcpCall`

Methods within each cluster share field access and belong together.

### Fix Group 2: StrategyItem.tsx: SC 1.1.1, SC 1.3.1, SC 2.1.1 +3 more

#### Findings

9 compliance findings in `src/app/src/pages/redteam/setup/components/strategies/StrategyItem.tsx`.

#### Remediation

- **sonde/web/barrel-import-bloat (barrel-import-bloat):** Named import { Lock, Settings } from 'lucide-react' pulls the package's full barrel module graph into the bundle (200-800ms import cost, slower builds and cold starts). Import each member directly from its source path (e.g. 'lucide-react/<member>') or add 'lucide-react' to Next.js optimizePackageImports.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **wcag-1.1.1-icon-label (Non-text Content):** Interactive <Checkbox> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add visible text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to provide an accessible name.
- **wcag-1.3.1-form-label (Info and Relationships):** <Checkbox> is missing an accessible label (no <label>, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add a <label for="id">, aria-label, or aria-labelledby attribute.
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <TestCaseGenerateButton> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <TestCaseGenerateButton> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <Checkbox> is missing an accessible label (no <label>, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** Interactive <Checkbox> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <TestCaseGenerateButton> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <TestCaseGenerateButton> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

### Fix Group 2: ScanStatistics.tsx: SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2, wcag

#### Findings

4 compliance findings in `src/app/src/pages/model-audit/components/ScanStatistics.tsx`.

#### Remediation

- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <StatCard> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <StatCard> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <StatCard> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <StatCard> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] wcag-2.1.1-keyboard: <StatCard> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
- [ ] wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value: <StatCard> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
- [ ] sonde/wcag/compliance: <StatCard> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
- [ ] sonde/wcag/compliance: <StatCard> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
